title: 5x-review-1: review sutra_explore skeleton + initial sutra-tend
description:
## Parent

sutra/169 — PRD: sutra_explore

## What to review

The sutra_explore tool exists end-to-end after slice sutra/170. Review:

- MCP interface shape: are the args and response contract right?
- Response structure: does the item/strategy/summary shape match the PRD spec?
- Basic grep→rank→assemble pipeline: does it work for a few real queries?
- Code placement: does `src/tools/explore.rs` follow the orient.rs/review.rs patterns?

**vidhi-sutra-tend moment:** The new `src/tools/explore.rs` module exists for the first time. Run sutra-tend to set initial constraints (forbidden deps, module boundaries) while the module is still small.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] MCP interface matches PRD spec
- [ ] Response shape verified against PRD
- [ ] Manual smoke test with 2-3 real queries
- [ ] Initial sutra constraints set for src/tools/explore.rs

## Blocked by

- sutra/170

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review of sutra/170 (c7961e5). Verdict: needs-attention. 4 findings:

1. [high] PRD summary contract incomplete — missing direct_matches, fan_out_items, components_touched fields
2. [high] Snake_case queries not expanded into split variants — "parse_imports" produces only literal, not "parse" + "imports"
3. [medium] Negative budget bypasses truncation — -1 cast to usize becomes huge
4. [medium] Nondeterministic ranking for equal scores — HashMap iteration order leaks through ties"

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Review complete. Codex adversarial review surfaced 4 findings (2 high, 2 medium), all fixed in 5a249fe. Sutra-tend pass: 2 constraints added (explore-no-similarity, explore-no-conventions), all bind, 0 new violations. Remaining AC: manual smoke test with real queries (deferred to user)."
